title: PurgeSMP
description: If one player dies, every player dies.
body:
![title](https://www.qclid.space/projects/purgebanner.png)
![features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c1883eac3bbe1157f344a0af30e116671fae3c0.png)
## 💀 Purge SMP
- Core mechanic : If one player dies, everyone on the server dies.
- Good for small smps.
- Kind of anti-pvp cause everyone dies.
## 🌟 Features
- Custom Death Messages
- /deaths command
- Per player death counter
- Minimessage support
- All messages are customizable!

## 💭 Idea
- This plugin is a fan creation of the purge smp that was held by SMii7Y
- [SMii7Y's original.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GvChOVOXeag&t=637s)
## 📜 How to install
- This plugin is totally plug and play compatible.
- Just drop the jar to you're servers plugins folder and you are good to go.

## ⚠️ Warning
- This absolutely just kills everyone in the server when a one dies so be careful on large servers. That will be chaotic.
- This plugin is primarily made for small smp servers.
